verdict: Meta has been dark for 6 days; leads have stopped arriving.
narrative: Your Meta ads went to zero spend on August 6th and have not run since — six consecutive dark days that account for the sharp drop in leads this week. The 28-day window still shows 64 leads at a cost of $25.27 each, but that activity all came from the first half of the period; nothing has come through in nearly a week. The improved cost-per-lead figure this period is not a real efficiency gain — it reflects spending far less, not performing better. Restoring Meta delivery is the immediate priority, and that work is already underway. Separately, your intake pipeline is being reviewed, as none of the 64 leads this period converted into tracked opportunities — that gap needs to be closed so future lead volume translates into cases.
